page.title: Tables & floor plan
page.subtitle: Draw your dining room so your team sees the tables as they are in the venue.
page.emptyTitle: You haven't drawn your dining room yet
page.emptyBody: In a minute you can place your tables, walls, bar and kitchen.
page.loadError: We couldn't load the floor plan.
page.noPermission: To change the floor plan, ask your admin for the “Configure tables and floor plan” permission.
page.narrow: To edit the floor plan, open it on a computer.
page.overLimit: This floor plan is larger than the editor allows. Write to us and we'll review it with you.
page.unplacedHint_one: It has no area, so your team doesn’t see it on the floor plan.
page.unplacedHint_other: They have no area, so your team doesn’t see them on the floor plan.

editor.title: Floor plan
editor.saved: Floor plan saved. Your team will see it when the point of sale refreshes.
editor.unsavedBody: You'll lose the changes you made to the floor plan.
editor.conflictTitle: Someone else changed the floor plan
editor.conflictBody: While you were editing, another person (or a terminal) saved changes. Reload to see them; your changes will be lost.
editor.offline: Not saved: no connection. Your changes are still here; try again.
editor.genericError: The floor plan couldn't be saved.
editor.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to save the floor plan.
editor.planLocked: Your plan no longer includes table service. Turn it on in Plan & billing to save the floor plan.
editor.noArea: Create an area (dining room, patio, bar…) to start drawing.
editor.orphans: You have walls or items from before with no area. They move into the first area you create; until then you can’t save.

areas.deleteBlocked: To delete it, first move or remove its tables.
areas.deleteBody: Its walls and elements will be deleted. It has no tables.

tools.LABEL: Label
tools.hint: Drag a piece onto the plan, or click it and then click the plan.
tools.placeHint: Click the plan where you want to put it. Esc to cancel.
tools.wallHint: Click where it starts and click where it ends. Double-click or Esc to finish.

inspector.nothing: Click a table or an item on the plan to change it.
inspector.removeBlocked: It has an open check: close it before removing it.
inspector.label: Name
inspector.manyHint: What you do here applies to everything selected.

tray.hint: Drag them onto the plan, or click one to put it in the middle.

newArea.title: New area
newArea.description: Give it a name and pick its shape. If you like, we'll lay out your first tables.
newArea.name: Name
newArea.tables: How many tables to start with?
newArea.nameTaken: There's already an area with that name
newArea.room_one: {{count}} more table fits on your plan.
newArea.room_other: {{count}} more tables fit on your plan.
newArea.noRoom: Your plan already has the maximum number of tables: start the area blank or place the ones you have.

preview.title: What your team will see
preview.note: Tables in red are an example of occupied tables. The point of sale will be updated to draw it the same way.

limits.tables: You reached the maximum of {{max}} tables.
limits.elements: You reached the maximum of {{max}} items (walls, bars, signs…).
limits.areas: You reached the maximum of {{max}} areas.

openOrders.body_one: Not saved: while its check is open it can’t be removed from the plan. Put it back, or close the check and save again.
openOrders.body_other: Not saved: while their checks are open they can’t be removed from the plan. Put them back, or close the checks and save again.

duplicates.title_one: More than one table has number {{numbers}}
duplicates.bodyNew_one: The new one uses the number of the table with an open check. Change the new one’s number to save.
duplicates.bodyNew_other: The new ones use the numbers of the tables with open checks. Change the new ones’ numbers to save.
duplicates.body_one: Change the number of one of them to save.
duplicates.body_other: Change the numbers so they don’t repeat, then save.
